name: Production Payment Orchestrator
tagline: Orchestrate high-volume payment switches through production outages, retries, and backoffs.
narrative:
You are Principal Payments Architect for YamusaPay.

Your switch processes a 500-transaction production stream—retail transfers, refunds, payroll payouts, business disbursements, and international settlements. Providers experience latency spikes, capacity exhaustion, and unexpected outages.

Your system must protect safety invariants: filter incompatible providers, safeguard urgent payroll/high-value payments, handle retries without repeating failed routes, and pass 10 adversarial test scenarios!
objective: Balance throughput, cost, reliability, deadlines, retries, compatibility, congestion, and customer impact across visible and hidden runs.
learningObjective: Design an enterprise payment orchestrator balancing real-time telemetry, provider capacity, and retry backoffs.
intelligenceExplanation:
Build your decision tree systematically:
1. Eligibility Invariants: Use `canRouteA/B/C` to reject incompatible or offline routes.
2. Service-Level Protection: Route urgent payroll, priority, and near-deadline work to fast, reliable providers.
3. Retry Management: Prevent retrying the same failed provider using `lastProvider` checks.
4. Cost & Congestion Optimization: Spread routine traffic across healthy providers before congestion cascades.
hint: Build in layers: eligibility first, service-level protection second, retry diversification third, and cost optimization fourth.
hints: Use lastProvider and retryCount to prevent repeating failed routes.
Submit evaluates your system across 10 hidden adversarial cases with unexpected outages.
brief: Manage a 500-transaction production stream across 10 adversarial hidden test scenarios.
context: 500 retail, refund, payroll, business, and settlement payments stream through 3 providers.

steps.label: Filter out incompatible, offline, or saturated providers
